Date: 2026-11-17T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: Helios Systems — onboarding packet & spend bands

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Attached is our completed onboarding packet and the spend forecast for Q1 (high level). A couple of things to call out we want to lock during onboarding:

- A provisional purchase reference (PO-like identifier) so we can start committing orders next week while procurement finishes legal review.
- A soft spend cap per month (initial ask: $120k) with an agreed escalation path if usage spikes.
- A couple of line-item corrections in the onboarding form: Helios charges for integration hours as a separate line ("Integration — one-time") whereas your template merged that into "professional services"; we need the split for our internal accounting.

Attached: helios_onboarding_form_filled.pdf (application/pdf), forecast_q1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Can you advise what information you need from our side to get a provisional purchase-ref issued and the spend band set? Also let us know if you need a PO number format to match your ledger.

Thanks,
Anya Roman

Helios Systems

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Anya Roman <procurement@helios-sys.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Helios Systems — onboarding packet & spend bands

Hi Anya — thanks for the packet and the clear ask. We're happy to get you a provisional purchase-ref so you can start booking integration work next week.

To issue that provisional ref I need:
1) Confirmation of the exact line-item split you want visible on invoices (please indicate line name + unit of measure).
2) The billing contact who will sign the provisional invoice (name + email).
3) Whether the $120k/month spend cap is a hard block or a soft alert (Redwood can enforce a hard spend cap at provisioning or simply alert when reached).

Quick answers below from our side: we usually issue a provisional purchase-ref in the format PRF-<6 digits>-<region> (e.g. PRF-004231-US). It can be converted to a formal PO later once legal signs. If you want a hard block we will route spend provisioning through a provisional escrow step which can delay activation by ~1 business day.

I've attached the onboarding form with our internal notes (minor NPI redactions) and marked the "Integration — one-time" as a separate SKU.

Attached: helios_onboarding_form_filled.pdf (application/pdf)

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Vendor Ops
Redwood Inference
[attachment: helios_onboarding_form_filled.pdf (application/pdf)]
